title: Business Rule
description: Schema for a business rule (BR-NNN) documented by Agente01_ProductOwner

description.description: Precise statement of the rule. Must be unambiguous and directly implementable.

rationale.description: Why this rule exists — business or regulatory reason

source.description: Origin of the rule: stakeholder name, document reference, regulation citation, or 'to confirm'
examples: System constraint: existing billing system policy

status.description: confirmed = stakeholder verified; to_confirm = not yet verified

applies_to.description: User stories (US-NNN), features, or system areas where this rule applies

related_open_questions.description: Open questions that must be resolved before this rule can be confirmed
